papers.title: GATE IN 2026 Trend-Based Mock Paper 1
papers.description: Sensors & Instrumentation emphasis with Control Systems and Electrical Circuits foundation. High-weightage topics prioritized for scoring.
papers.predictionRationale: Sensors & Instrumentation leads with transducers, signal conditioning, and measurement systems.
